notes: ROBOTS - CHECKED ON BOTH HOSTS, because robots is per-host and the sitemap lives on the www host. (a) https://nkuku.com/robots.txt: HTTP 200, 6,957 bytes, profile edge101. (b) https://www.nkuku.com/robots.txt: HTTP 200, byte-identical at 6,957 bytes, profile firefox133. NEITHER names a Claude agent - a regex sweep for claude/anthropic over both files returned ZERO matches - so there is no named-agent Disallow and no hard stop. Both declare the same seven groups: '*', adsbot-google, Nutch ('Disallow: /'), AhrefsBot (Crawl-delay 10), AhrefsSiteAudit (Crawl-delay 10), MJ12bot (Crawl-delay 10) and Pinterest (Crawl-delay 1). The only blanket Disallow: / is under Nutch, which is not us and whose rules therefore do not apply. The '*' group declares NO Crawl-delay, so only probe.py's 2 s per-host gap applied and it was honoured. The '*' Disallow list covers /admin, /cart, /carts, /account, /orders, /checkout(s), /policies/, /search, /services/login_with_shop, /.well-known/shopify/monorail, /recommendations/products, /cdn/wpm/*.js, the sort/filter traps '/collections/*sort_by*', '/collections/*+*' (and %2B/%2b), '*/collections/*filter*&*filter*', the oseid/preview_theme_id/preview_script_id traps, AND - important here - 'Disallow: /*section_id=' and 'Disallow: /id=predictive-search'. COMPLIANCE: because /*section_id= is disallowed on this site, Shopify's section-rendering endpoint was NOT used at any point (it was used on a different company earlier in this batch where robots permitted it; here it is off limits and the mega-menu was taken from the page HTML instead). Every URL touched is a bare /collections/<handle> or /collections/<handle>?page=N, or a sitemap file. No sort_by, no '+', no filter parameter, no internal /search. ACCESS: plain direct probe.py curl_cffi fetches (edge101, firefox133, safari15_5, safari18_0_ios and others) - no proxy, no jina, no campaign parameter, no browser automation, zero 403s, no challenge. TREE SOURCE - three independent surfaces, all Nkuku's own, and the collections sitemap did indeed beat the mega-menu. (1) THE MEGA-MENU, parsed out of the server-rendered page HTML (<details> block): 'Home Accessories > Bathroom' contains exactly Soap Dishes (/collections/soap-dishes), Soap Dispensers (/collections/soap-dispensers), Bathroom Accessories (/collections/bathroom-accessories), Hooks & Rails (/collections/decorative-hooks), Laundry Baskets (/collections/laundry-baskets) and View All (/collections/all-bathroom). Sibling menu sections walked in the same pass: Mirrors (Wall Mirrors, Full Length Mirrors, Round Mirrors, View All), Storage & Utility (Baskets, Storage & Shelving, Hooks & Rails, Coat Hooks, Fireside, Laundry Baskets, Wine Racks), Decorative Accessories, Vases & Planters, Candles & Candle Holders, Home Fragrance, plus the whole Furniture, Sofas, Lighting, Garden and Kitchen & Dining trees. (2) EACH PLP'S OWN CHILD CAROUSEL, div.quick-links__carousel - this is what the mega-menu truncates and it recovered TWO nodes the menu never shows: the All Bathroom page's carousel yields Bathroom Accessories, BATHROOM LIGHTING and BATHROOM STORAGE. (3) THE COLLECTIONS SITEMAP https://www.nkuku.com/sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml, 781 collection URLs, regex-swept for bath|shower|toilet|soap|basin|sink|tap|faucet|vanity|mirror|towel|wash|dispenser|toothbrush|sanitar|bidet|robe|laundry|hook. This recovered the last two bathroom nodes, BOTH of which are unlinked from the mega-menu AND from every quick-links carousel: /collections/bathroom-furniture and /collections/bathroom-mirrors. I verified they are orphans rather than mis-read nav by scanning the raw HTML of all-bathroom, bathroom-accessories, mirrors, all-furniture, all-house-home, storage-shelving and all-storage-utility for a link to either handle - not one of those seven pages references them; only storage-shelving even links bathroom-storage. Both are nonetheless genuine live category pages: HTTP 200, H1 'Bathroom Furniture' and 'Bathroom Mirrors', self-referential rel=canonical, and bathroom-specific product sets. They are recorded, and their orphan status is disclosed here. QTY SOURCE: the exact figure the listing page prints itself, verbatim 'N items' (rendered server-side alongside 'See N items' in the filter panel with 'Clear all' showing, i.e. an unfiltered total). No API, no JSON-LD numberOfItems, no meta-description number, no nav-attribute count - none of the three proven traps. VERIFICATION - EVERY node was reconciled against a direct count of div.product-card elements in the same HTML, paginating where needed. Page size is 36. Exact agreement on all ten bathroom-family nodes: All Bathroom 22 header / 22 cards; Bathroom Accessories 48 header / 36 cards page 1 + 12 cards page 2 = 48; Bathroom Storage 26/26; Bathroom Lighting 7/7; Bathroom Furniture 2/2; Bathroom Mirrors 4/4; Soap Dishes 6/6; Soap Dispensers 5/5; Laundry Baskets 4/4; Wall & Decorative Hooks 20/20. Controls outside the bathroom tree behaved the same way (Wall Mirrors 33/33, Floor Length Mirrors 5/5, Decorative Mirrors 10/10). All five recorded leaves are single-page, so each recorded figure is a complete enumeration, not a first-page artifact - proven by the one node that DOES paginate (Bathroom Accessories) resolving exactly to its header. DISCRIMINATION: counts differ node by node across the 18 collections fetched (2, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6, 7, 10, 20, 22, 26, 33, 39, 42, 48, 54, 195, 298) - no site-wide constant - and each page's H1 and rel=canonical matched the node requested. OVERLAP DISCLOSURE - Nkuku's bathroom collections are overlapping merchandising sets, not a strict tree, so every pairwise overlap was measured by product handle and is stated rather than hidden. Bathroom Accessories (48) strictly CONTAINS Soap Dishes (6/6), Soap Dispensers (5/5), Laundry Baskets (4/4) and Bathroom Furniture (2/2), and holds 24 of Bathroom Storage's 26 - that is why it is excluded as the roll-up. Among the five RECORDED leaves the overlaps are partial, not containment: Bathroom Storage shares 2 products with Soap Dishes, 3 with Soap Dispensers and 2 with Bathroom Furniture; Bathroom Mirrors is disjoint from all four others. These are five distinct, distinctly-titled site categories at five distinct URLs, so under rule 28 they are five records; no quantity is ever summed and no parent number is ever reused. CONTENT CHECKS on the recorded leaves: Bathroom Storage - Olani/Amandi/Mahi toilet roll holders, Olani towel ring, Olani bathroom hooks, Indore wall shelf, Mahi and Sukha storage caddies, Ilcoso and Valeska recycled-glass soap dispensers and storage pots (rules 12/13/14/17 all name these). Bathroom Furniture - Mahi Wall Shelf With Towel Rail and Mahi Wall Mounted Toilet Roll Holder (rule 9). Bathroom Mirrors - Almora Round Mirror large and small, Almora Oval Mirror, Yadur Rectangular Mirror in antique brass; primary product type is mirror, so rule 11 sends it to BATHROOM and rule 10 forbids letting the word 'Bathroom' exclude it. Soap Dishes and Soap Dispensers are rule-13 accessories outright. Material is no bar (rule 22): recycled glass, brass, mango wood, travertine, rattan and iron all qualify. WHAT WAS EXCLUDED AND WHY: All Bathroom as an explicit View All (rule 25); Bathroom Accessories as the overlapping roll-up; Laundry Baskets as fully subsumed and storage-owned (rule 12); Wall & Decorative Hooks as a general storage/decor node; Bathroom Lighting to Lighting (rules 11/19), including the Akurdi Bathroom Mirror Light, which is a LIGHT and not a mirror; the whole general Mirrors family (42, with Wall 33 / Floor 5 / Decorative 10 and the attribute collections round-, arch-, brass-, rectangle-mirrors) to Decor under rule 2; and the sale collections (all-sale, sale-mirrors, mirrors-sale, sale-home-decor, sale-10/20/30/40/50/60-percent-off, christmas-sale) as promotional pages under rule 25 - never recorded, never counted. DEDUP: dedup.already_extracted() was run on every candidate leaf, every review node and every rel=canonical target. ZERO hits on anything bathroom. The exclusion index holds 28 nkuku.com URLs, ALL from Furniture.xlsx and all in the general furniture tree - sofas, armchairs, occasional chairs, dining chairs and benches, bar stools, desks, desk chairs, footstools, side/coffee/console/dining/bedside tables, cabinets & sideboards, chest of drawers, wardrobes, beds & headboards, bedroom and storage benches, freestanding shelves, garden seating and bistro sets. Critically, /collections/bathroom-furniture is NOT among them - the Furniture pass took Nkuku's general furniture tree but never its bathroom-furniture node - so the Option-1 suppression does not bite here and the 2-product Bathroom Furniture leaf is genuinely new. Nkuku's mirror collections are likewise absent from Final.xlsx. NOT PRESENT ON THIS SITE (established by the 781-URL sitemap sweep plus the full mega-menu walk, not assumed): no sanitaryware, basins, sinks, toilets or bidets; no baths or bathtubs; no showers or shower systems; no enclosures, screens or doors; no taps, mixers or faucets; no vanity units; no bath towels, bath mats, shower curtains or robes (Nkuku's textiles are cushions, throws, quilts and bed linen). RESULT: 1 grouping row + 5 leaf rows (6 / 5 / 26 / 2 / 4), 6 review entries.
